name: Always-on agent skills
tagline: Three skills that run on every project I build: a privacy scanner, auto-save and notifications.
summary: Every agent I build inherits the same three skills as Claude Code hooks. A privacy scanner checks each tool call before it runs, an auto-save skill checkpoints the session and pushes my work whenever Claude pauses, and a notifications skill pings me when Claude finishes or needs approval while I'm in another app.
problem: Each new agent needed the same safety checks and plumbing, and I kept losing context or missing the moment Claude needed me while I was in another window.
how: Privacy scanner: before every tool call, it checks for secrets, personal details and health or financial data, and stops on a match.
Auto-save: whenever Claude pauses, it writes a session checkpoint, summarises what changed, then commits and pushes (at most every 3 minutes).
Notifications: native macOS pings when Claude is done or waiting for approval, sent only when I'm not looking at the editor.
Templates keep every new agent on the same Workflow, Agent, Tool pattern, so the skills plug in automatically.
highlights: Runs on every agent I build
